name: on_entity_death
title: world.on_entity_death
lead: Tells after a mob died; it is gone, so its id and name is all there is. Mob kinds only.

usedIn.quote: - At 0 health it dies as a mob: it falls over, leaves its `drops`, and is gone a second later. `on_remove` gets `"killed"`, and `world.on_entity_death` fires.
world.on_entity_death(function(id, name) end) -> connection    -- a mob died; it is gone, so id and name is all there is
